body:
burrow new <name> generates a real, immediately-runnable starter (.prn + main.go + go.mod), actually runs it through EmitGo + go build before returning success. Go target only in v0. go test 101/101. Real end-to-end proof: built binary, generated a scaffold, ran it, correct output. Commit 47e1246.

⚓ ☃
title: burrow new: real batteries-included scaffolding command (kanban PXCL-001)
